No network operations, code execution, or file modifications occur at build or install time beyond unpacking and manifest generation. All operations are confined to the package directory. The dependencies and optdepends are appropriate for a GUI application using WebKit and Vulkan. There is no obfuscated code, unexpected downloads, or suspicious commands.
